industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Econergy
summary: Econergy Renewable Energy Ltd operates as an independent power producer, specializing in the full lifecycle of utility-scale sustainable energy projects, encompassing their development, ownership, and ongoing management. These initiatives are dedicated to generating and supplying electrical power. The company's operational assets include facilities harnessing solar, wind, and bio-gas technologies. Econergy Renewable Energy Ltd is headquartered in Kfar Saba, Israel.
